column1: INSTRUCTIONS - Read Before Filling. Delete These Instruction Lines Before Uploading.
1. All columns are mandatory. Do not leave any cell blank.
2. Do not rename, reorder, add or remove columns. Keep the header row exactly as given.
3. USN: Enter the student's University Seat Number exactly as in Salesforce (e.g., DSUOE25800MBA0025). Do not include spaces.
4. Fee Assignment: Enter the Fee Assignment number from the student's fee record (e.g., FA-0187). It must belong to the USN in the same row.
5. Payment Date: Use DD/MM/YYYY format only (e.g., 02/11/2026). Future dates are not allowed.
6. Payment Option: Enter exactly one of the following: Online, Cash, Credit Card, Debit Card, Cheque, RTGS, NEFT. Spelling must match.
7. Payment Amount: Enter numbers only, without the rupee symbol, commas or spaces (e.g., 50000 or 50000.00). The amount must not exceed the pending amount on the fee assignment.
8. Transaction ID: Enter the reference number from the payment gateway, bank, card slip or cheque number.
9. CRM Receipt Number: Enter the receipt number generated in CRM for this payment. It must be unique.
10. Settlement UTR: Enter the UTR/bank settlement reference for the payment. It must be unique.
11. Enter one payment per row. To pay more than one fee assignment for a student, use separate rows.
12. Save the file as CSV (Comma delimited) .csv, not .xlsx. Open it in Excel only for verification, as Excel may change dates and long numbers.
13. After uploading, click Validate. Correct any failed rows using Edit, then click Import.
